lines: Perforce Puppet Enterprise: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability

Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request.
